programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.desc: The Heat is a daily talk show anchored from Washington, D.C. It focuses on top stories making news globally. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight’s Code
programme.desc: Po and Blade's personalities clash as they track Klaus and Veruca and fight off some of Po's old foes. Blade gets to see Po's kung fu mastery, but doesn't agree to team up with him until she realizes that he accidentally holds the key to finding Klaus and Veruca: he has a piece of the WuGao Gauntlet. Meanwhile, Klaus and Veruca continue on their path of destruction while looking for the mysterious "Lotus".

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lotus
programme.desc: Po's moral lines are blurred when he and Blade have to break an untrustworthy hedgehog monk (Zhen) out of jail to get more information on what Klaus and Veruca stole from the Lotus. They learn from Zhen that there are in fact three more weapons, and Po recognizes one of them from a comic book.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Terra Incognita Part One
programme.desc: The evil General Morando launches a coup on the alien planet Akiridion-5. In the ensuing battle, the planet's King and Queen are severely injured, and their surviving son Krel and daughter Aja escape the planet with military commander, Varvatos Vex. They seek refuge on a backwater planet: Earth.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Terra Incognita Part Two
programme.desc: Aja, Krel, and Vex explore Earth looking for technology to repair their ship. When the high school Principal demands to meet Aja and Krel's guardians, the Royal teens transform two maintenance robots (Blanks) to pose as their "human" parents.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: In an effort to blend in with their surroundings, Krel engineers a device to get into the "mind-set" of humans and ends up discovering far more than he expected. Meanwhile, General Morando's bounty hunters close in on the Royals.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that she’s afraid to try new things because she doesn’t want to make mistakes-why mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cakey’s Cupcake Cousins
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakey's Cousins are coming to visit! Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercat's potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hare Hops
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hare didn't hop. He was one of the speediest animals in Tinga Tinga but none of the other animals wanted to race with him because Hare always won and it was becoming boring. Then one day, slow but clever Tortoise decides to challenge Hare.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Mosquito Buzzes
programme.desc: You see there was time when Mosquito didn't buzz. Mosquito was as quiet as quiet can be… and did she like to tell tales. One day Mosquito tells the Monkeys that the sun looks very low in the sky. ‘Maybe it's sad and doesn't want to rise!' worry the Monkeys.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Cornish Caper
programme.desc: Ted Glenn's Cornish cousin Ned is sending him a steam engine as an alternative means to power his workshop. Pat and Jess set off to Cornwall to collect this very large special delivery in the SDS Plane whilst Ted sets about giving away all of his old inventions to the people of Greendale in order to clear out enough space for the engine. Pat and Jess meet the eccentric Ned Glenn at his workshop and wrestle with the crate containing the heavy engine to get it aboard the plane.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Giant Pumpkin
programme.desc: Pat has to deliver some pumpkins to Greendale School for the annual Halloween Pumpkin Party. But when he picks them up from Ted's workshop, Jess starts playing with a giant pumpkin and it rolls into the river and floats away. Pat follows it along the river and tries to fish it out with Alf's rod but the pumpkin is too heavy and the line breaks. As the party gets under way in Greendale, the giant pumpkin floats out to sea and Pat and Jess board the SDS Orca and head out into Pencaster Bay.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Karmageddon Chet Gets Burned
programme.desc: Turbo is excited to race on a freeway that is closed for construction, but he needs to complete a series of favors for the crew before he can go. Burn breaks up with Chet after he forgets her birthday. To make Burn jealous, Turbo dresses up as a girl and pretends to be Chet's new girlfriend.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Gypsy Moth Prophecies Skidzo-Brainia
programme.desc: A fortune-telling moth forecasts doom for Whiplash and though Whip is skeptical, the crew tries to keep him safe so the it doesn't come true. Skidmark learns the crew is tired of his crazy behavior so he invents a helmet that changes his personality in unpredictable ways.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Sleepy Toys
programme.desc: Everyone in Brickabuild keeps falling asleep and no one can get any building work finished. It's all because the lights keep coming on all night! Noddy decides to investigate who is turning the lights on. Bravely overcoming his own fear of the dark, he follows the clues to discover that the lights are being secretly turned on by a scared Carlton, who doesn't like the dark.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Secret Deliveries
programme.desc: Someone is giving presents to everyone in Toyland and all the toys want to say thank you but no one knows the identity of the secret gift giver! It's up to Noddy to investigate and find out who is it that's leaving presents for all the friends. By following clues and using his investigation skills, Noddy follows the trail to Animal Acres and discovers that Pat Pat and the Pockets are the secret gift-givers.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Little Lost Toy
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is delighted because a little clockwork duck has appeared at the DinoLab. No one knows where she belongs but Noddy is sure that her family must be missing her so he decides to investigate and find her home. Noddy uses all his skills of thinking, looking, listening and asking questions to find the home for the little duck.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of Jumpy Revs
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in Toyland. Lots of things seem to be jumping in a particular direction for no reason - Revs, Noddy's bell, Big Ear's spoons and kettle. What is going on? Noddy decides to investigate and help his best friend Revs who is very upset.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Go Dog Go! S2 - The Puppy Whisperer Doggy Book of World Records
programme.desc: Tag becomes jealous when Yip prefers to spend time with puppy-sitter Beans instead of with her. Frank and Beans find out that Tag and Scooch are trying to get into the Doggy Book of World Records and sabotage every attempt. When Tag and Scooch find out what the sneaky duo are up to, they come up with a plan to outsmart them.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Lair
programme.desc: D-Structs kidnaps Revvit to show the crew who's boss when they compete over construction, so Ty plans the perfect heist to rescue their friend.

programme.desc: Lucky gets into trouble when the circus picks up a stranded woman who isn't what she seems

programme.desc: You see there was a time when Lion had lost his roar. Crocodile was snapping at all the animals in the Waterhole and Lion opened his big mouth but nothing came out! Tiny Flea tells Lion that if he dares to enter the Great Cave of Tinga Tinga then maybe he will find his roar. Lion plucks up courage and goes into the Great Cave. He roars with all his might, but a bigger roar comes back! Lion stands strong. He roars again and an even bigger roar comes back.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Zebra Has Stripes
programme.desc: Zebra was once very easy to spot in Tinga Tinga as he was bright white all over. This very annoying as all he wanted was to be left alone to munch on yummy grass and get fat. One day, Eagle arrives at the Watering Hole with a new pair of sharp talons saying that she found them in the Great Cave. The animals excitedly rush to find something for themselves. Zebra accompanies Tortoise and the Monkeys into the Cave where they discover the last remaining item; a plain black coat.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat's Pancake Party
programme.desc: Pat must deliver eggs, milk, flour and butter to Greendale for the annual Pancake Race. But when Michael mixes all the ingredients together, Pat finds that he instead has to deal with a mixing bowl full to the brim with pancake mix... Meanwhile in Greendale, Sara's attempts at pancake-tossing aren't going well and she soon loses her pancake under the wheels of PC Selby's car.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Runaway Remote
programme.desc: Pat doesn't realise today's Special Delivery, a super all-in-one remote control, is quite as powerful as it is! As Jess falls asleep on the buttons, machines all around Pencaster start going haywire. Waiting for the remote, Charlie and Julian are installing a futuristic 'Shop a Bot 3000' robot sales assistant for Mrs Goggins, but they make the mistake of turning it on before the controller arrives. Pat struggles to make his delivery before the shop robot does too much damage!

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Primrose Classic The Blimpateers
programme.desc: A professional paper airplane thrower hires Archibald to be his caddie. While floating through the sky, Archibald bumps into birds who live in a blimp.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Mall Walkers Treasured Tattoo
programme.desc: Archibald stumbles upon a crime in progress while trapped in the mall overnight. A whale's tattooed map inspires Archibald to go on a treasure hunt.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Sticky Putty
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in Brickabuild. Clockwork Mouse is giving all sorts of confusing orders to the builders and everything is chaos. Noddy realises that someone has put sticky putty on her clockwork key and it's making her run slowly. Noddy decides to investigate and find out who could have tried to damage the little mouse.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Toyland Accidents
programme.desc: Something strange is happening in Toyland - trees are falling down and machines are going crazy. What's going on? Noddy needs to use all his investigating skills to find out who is causing all the accidents before someone gets hurt. He realises that Deltoid is trying to help and be a superhero but hasn't realised that his superstrength is causing chaos! Noddy shows him how to be a super helpful superhero without causing anymore accidents! Well done Noddy!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Blue Wall
programme.desc: Everyone is going to play Hide and Seek in Brickabuild but Fuse stops the game because someone has painted the big wall outside his workshop blue! What if they do it again? Or if they decide to paint the rest of Brickabuild? Noddy uses all his investigating skills of who, what, where, when, why and how to work out that the wall must have been painted by someone very tall who likes the colour blue.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Fable Forest Gold
programme.desc: The Pirates are searching for the long-lost Fable Forest Gold. If they can't find it they might have to stop being pirates for good! Noddy leaps into action to help them. Using all his investigating skills, asking who, what, where, when, why and how and with the help of the wwwbook Noddy follows the clues and finds the gold! Now the pirates can stay in Toyland and hunt for treasure forever! Hurrah for Noddy!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Easter Kitty Bunny
programme.desc: It’s Easter-time in the dollhouse! When Gabby unboxes an Easter basket with an orange egg inside, all the Gabby Cats want to know what’s inside, but when CatRat accidentally sends it rolling out of Kitty Fairy’s garden, Gabby and Pandy go on a springtime search through the Dollhouse to find it. Then, when the egg hatches, they meet Eggy, the Easter Kitty Bunny! For our Cat of the Day segment, Baby Box gets crafty.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Sick Day
programme.desc: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Bad Egg
programme.desc: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harper's drone flies away it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylan's first lost tooth experience.

Then, when the egg hatches, they meet Eggy, the Easter Kitty Bunny! For our Cat of the Day segment, Baby Box gets crafty.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Mom’s Birthday Angry
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruz’s help to perform a dance for Mom’s birthday. Though it’s hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Tuskist Three Moon Festival
programme.desc: Scallop is afraid of her first "tuskist" appointment. Kelp helps her get through it with a song. Fog rolls in, threatening Kelp’s first Three Moon Festival in Unicorn Land. Kelp and his friends use a combination of unicorn spark and the Kelp Way to create a new festival.

programme.title: Go Dog Go! S2 - Happy Pawtomotiversary Winner, Winner, Lasagna Dinner
programme.desc: Pawston is celebrating the 40th anniversary of Grandmaw and Grandpaw's Pawtomotive Garage! As a surprise, Tag and Paw decide to track down items to recreate the garage to look like it did when it first opened while the rest of the family distract the Grandpawrents. Tag and Wind face off in the Lasagna Games for a chance to be Sam’s new Crew Chief. A series of lasagna-themed games will challenge their speed, fix-it skills, and leadership. But there can only be one winner.

programme.title: Go Dog Go! S2 - Bites, Camera, Action! Stay, Dog. Stay!
programme.desc: When Tag finds out that Pawston has a chance to host the Dogcathalon Race, she and Scooch rush around to create a movie to show why their city should host. Unfortunately everything seems to go wrong. Will Tag and Scooch be able to save their movie before time runs out? When Tag's construction project accidentally damages Frank and Beans’ house, she invites them to stay with her family during repairs. Tag does her best to keep Frank and Beans busy so they don’t get in the Barkers’ way.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Racetrack
programme.desc: Ton-Ton's friends, The 'Dumps, visit the Flatirons but are too wild and crazy for the crew, so the Dinotrux build a racetrack perfect for joyriding.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Two-Wheeled Terror
programme.desc: When Lucky and the PALs arrive home from the circus, they find that Maricela and her new bicycle have become the star attraction in Miradero

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Munk History Happy Howl Day
programme.desc: Grug tries to solve the mystery of where Munk's family is Eep refuses to join in when Ahhh! Valley celebrates their first holiday, "Howl Day"

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Snooty And The Beasts Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: After rescuing Kevin and almost having a first kiss, Eep sets up dangerous situations to recreate the moment; Grug and Snoot go on a rescuemission

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Reign Of Fireworms
programme.desc: Fireworms invade Dragon's Edge, while Ruffnut and Tuffnut discover that they have an unexpected connection to the island.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Crushing It
programme.desc: As a Rumblehorn wreaks havoc on Dragon's Edge, Hiccup seeks the help of Stoick - who forms an unexpected bond with the rampaging beast.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Veruca’s mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Veruca’s rekindled powers.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cupcake Tree
programme.desc: When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert Cakey to work together to shrink the overgrown cupcake tree branch by branch--and to save CatRat from where he's stuck at the top! For our COTD segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Par Avion
programme.desc: When Mega Fat tries to get Boss Baby fired while on an airplane to Pairs, Tim and Staci must prevent a baby meltdown

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Cat Cop!
programme.desc: When baby families are leaving town, Boss Baby and Tim battle to prove Bootsy is behind it all

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Hang in There, Baby
programme.desc: When Mega Fat CEO Baby claims he has dirt that could get Boss Baby fired, Boss Baby and the team try to find a way to get it first!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Flustering Mindless Woe of the Flushable Memory Wipes
programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Soggy Salvation of the Swirling Sweatnami
programme.desc: Tired of mean Mr. Krupp, the boys go back in time to prevent him from becoming a bully, but discover that their plan has backfired when they return to the present

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Sickening Fumes of Smartsy Fartsy
programme.desc: In order to retrieve Mr. Krupp’s locked up rule book, George and Harold use an invention that ends up turning against them

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Bem-Vindo ao Rio
programme.desc: After losing their mission materials in quicksand, Tony decides to channel Dom and Blend in to get intel from the people of Rio. Unfortunately it's more difficult than he expected, and Tony and his crew are picked up by a group of favela gangsters in a neighborhood that worships a mysterious young female martyr. The crew is relieved to find that Layla is in charge of the gangsters - until she orders the gangsters to dispose of them!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Combustion
programme.desc: Tony is convinced that Layla is deep undercover and tries to talk to her alone to get through to her. Meanwhile, the crew investigates the gang’s production of the mysterious formula from the tattoo. When Frostee discovers that the product of the formula is unstable and will explode, Tony has to save Layla, who is driving a whole truck of it!

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Between A Rock And A Hard Place
programme.desc: When Hiccup and the Riders discover that Viggo is using two captured Catastrophic Quakens to build a dragon prison, they must help the dragons escape.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Family On The Edge
programme.desc: When Dagur comes to Dragon's Edge looking for Heather, Hiccup tries to keep the two siblings apart by teaching Dagur the art of Dragon Riding.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Last Auction Heroes
programme.desc: When the Riders uncover the location of Viggo's Dragon Auction, they must stop him from selling dragons and stealing all the gold in Berk.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - The Reckless Club
programme.desc: Jim and his friends are trapped in detention while tensions in Trollmarket escalate with fears of Gunmar's escape

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Unbecoming
programme.desc: Jim is given the chance to see what life would be like if he had never picked up the Amulet

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Mistrial And Error
programme.desc: Jim must go to trial for releasing Gunmar from the Darklands

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

With insight from teammates, coaches, and opponents, we explore the intelligence, discipline, and influence that made his name synonymous with the position he perfected.

programme.title: GURU KARATEKU KECE BADAI
programme.desc: Distracted by her own heavy thoughts, Andini (Ariel Tatum) accidentally hits Damar (Lucky Perdana) with her motorcycle. She manages to flee, but Damar later finds her being chased by a group of people. Even though Damar saves her, he's annoyed because instead of thanking him, Andini lashes out. However, knowing Damar is a karate instructor, Andini eventually begs him to be her personal bodyguard.

programme.title: DEWI RINDU - EP154
programme.desc: Dewi is a girl with big dreams. She is determined to become successful and lift her family out of economic hardship. But who would have thought that her beautiful dream would be shattered and she would have to face the bitter reality of being pregnant out of wedlock.

programme.title: Bule Depok Minta Dinaturalisasi Demi Cinta
programme.desc: Rafael (Dylan Carr) is a handsome foreigner living in a local village, but there's a catch: he speaks Indonesian with a thick, comical Javanese accent, earning him the nickname 'Bule Depok.' He falls in love with Aminah (Syahnaz Sadiqah), a beautiful traditional dodol vendor. While Aminah feels the same, her father is strictly against her marrying a foreigner, insisting that she should only be with a local man.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta - EP608
programme.desc: The love story between Ocean and Cinta, which had always quarreled before. Gradually, they became friends and slowly grew in love between them. But a secret between the Cinta family and the Samudra family makes their relationship complicated because there is a big secret about Cinta that can ruin their relationship.

programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP1
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP11
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr - EP16
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Succession War - EP2
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP12
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP12
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP2
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 熟年(台)第22集
programme.desc: 張春梅生活在外人看來堪稱完美，變故出現在倪老太太的壽宴，張春梅的老公、倪家的小兒子倪偉強居然無故缺席，而且電話失聯…

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第9集
programme.desc: 突破一般記錄報導影片，平實卻易流於平淡無味的刻板手法，另類開創了戶外探險、旅遊行腳節目，深度好看、知性感性兼顧，又能將文字與音樂有如行雲流水般的自然融入，重要的是，我們及時保存下許多消逝的聲音、消逝的物種、消逝的故事…

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第288集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 2024揚州講壇第21集
programme.desc: 秉持星雲大師以弘揚“人間佛教”為宗風，樹立“以文化弘揚佛法，以教育培養人才，以慈善福利社會，以共修淨化人心”宗旨，致力推動佛教文化，教育、慈善、弘法事業，將佛教帶往現代化的新里程碑。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1722集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第288集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第9集
programme.desc: 突破一般記錄報導影片，平實卻易流於平淡無味的刻板手法，另類開創了戶外探險、旅遊行腳節目，深度好看、知性感性兼顧，又能將文字與音樂有如行雲流水般的自然融入，重要的是，我們及時保存下許多消逝的聲音、消逝的物種、消逝的故事…

programme.title: 生活快易通第69集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 美麗人生壯志高飛第451集
programme.desc: 台視60周年台慶大戲《美麗人生》第五單元《壯志高飛》，以1960年代高雄市旗津島為故事起點，三位最美麗的台灣女人，在台灣最美麗的年代，在最美麗的旗津，悲歡交織而成的美麗人生。數百年前，旗津還沒有一個統一的名稱，島的南端依舊與高雄相連。 而後，為了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名喚『崩隙』的這片沙土挖空了，居民被迫遷移，旗津也因而斷開 了與台灣的連繫，猶如遊子，離開了母親的懷抱。土地會消失，歷史也許會被淡忘，但曾經走過那段艱辛歲月的人們，他們的悲歡離合、笑容與淚水，仍將會轉化為孕育後代子孫的養分，開出燦爛的花朵。這是屬於我們上一代人的故事，也是我們這一代人的故事，是所有在這座島嶼上奮鬥的人們的—《

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第61集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第188集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第63集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第568集
programme.desc: 《多謝款待》由渡邊杏主演，東出昌大、財前直見、原田泰造、木村綠子、近藤正臣等共同出演。該劇講述了主人公芽以子從大正年間直到第二次世界大戰結束的數十年間，以飽含心意的美食支持著身邊的人，並始終堅守對丈夫的愛的故事。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第63集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: 水返腳的春天第36集
programme.desc: 「水返腳」，就是現今「汐止」。當靜芬見到山田，才知道他們在這山區住了二十年，卻沒見過對方。心寬念純的靜芬，人生的功課，包括：勇敢的擁抱養母說出愛；調柔一絲不苟固執的山田；小學畢業程度卻能參加筆耕隊，寫作盲人與退伍老兵的感人文章登載於報紙，她的心路歷程，見證了單純能提升正面向上的力量。

programme.title: 365日日素第129集

programme.title: 仁心慧語第481集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 行動現場第468集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第40集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 生活地球村第265集
programme.desc: 《生活地球村》是一個以環境、印尼當地智慧以及食物潛力為主題的紀錄片節目。本節目的製作是為了帶領觀眾意識並邀請大家在生活中實踐環保、愛護地球。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 無量義經偈頌第65集
programme.desc:
《無量義經》被譽為《法華經》的前導，也是大乘佛法中最能啟發慈悲行的經典。對證嚴上人而言，這部經是畢生體悟最深的法門，更成為慈濟法脈的根本依據。在 上人的帶領下，《無量義經》成為慈濟人行入人群的實踐指南。
本節目以 上人講解的《無量義經》偈頌為主軸，帶領觀眾把經中智慧用在生活的每個當下，願人人能從這部經中啟發無量善念，為自己與社會帶來更多和諧與光亮。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第644集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1965集

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第645集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第1966集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.title: 霹靂俠峰
programme.desc: 北境三劍論俠峰，萬魔之罪七皇蹤， 河圖鬼智計無諝，岳雲深處現玉龍。 奉天逍遙踏入三途流域，又會開啟怎樣的旅程？名劍絕世與皇劍孤臣，能否解開白羽境天道之謎，阻止八歧邪神與死神？莫召奴、談無慾、淨琉璃等中原群俠，又該如何應對未知的危機？煉魔塔又是怎樣的存在？逆神七皇究竟是哪七人？欲知一連串精彩發展，盡在霹靂俠峰。

programme.title: 野球名人房
programme.desc: NOWnews Podcast節目《野球名人房》上線啦！全新企劃以棒球為主軸，在節目中要分享各種你最想知道的棒球話題，不論是「想當年的那一場球」、「傳奇球星近況」、還是大家最喜歡的「爆料大會」應有盡有！當然本節目的主持人也是大有來頭，由「叫你總欸出來打」東哥黃忠義以及「活潑女星」何美搭檔主持

programme.title: 霹靂狼煙之九輪燎原
programme.desc: 清荷元年開新局──葬神之野上，四心開天，九輪天啟降世之道，天譩之間內，天譩以九輪共裁之身分，統合境內各大勢力，強勢入侵，更有逆三教首腦神機接應，這場策畫多年的境界之戰，勢將動盪苦境江山，赮畢鉢羅為首之一際雲川、墨傾池主持的文詣經緯，地限所率領的道鎮伏魔崖等三教勢力，以及秉持黑暗正義捍衛武林的魔吞不動城，能承擔九輪力壓，為苦境中原開出一片光明嗎？

programme.desc: 清荷元年開新局──葬神之野上，四心開天，九輪天啟降世之道，天譩之間內，天譩以九輪共裁之身分，統合境內各大勢力，強勢入侵，更有逆三教首腦神機接應，這場策畫多年的境界之戰，勢將動盪苦境江山，赮畢鉢羅為首之一際雲川、墨傾池主持的文詣經緯，地限所率領的道鎮伏魔崖等三教勢力，以及秉持黑暗正義捍衛武林的魔吞不動城，能承擔九輪力壓，為苦境中原開出一片光明嗎？

programme.title: 只此一家
programme.desc: 馬麗敏是房地產公司「只此一家」的老闆娘，心中懷抱成功的宏大目標。 她帶著兒子郝仁品在地產界闖蕩，母子聯手在競爭激烈的市場中一步步站穩腳步。 丈夫郝健則與室內設計師萬德福合力經營「好運裝修公司」，專責裝修與設計事務。 兩家公司互相配合，一家人齊心協力，幫助客戶們打造理想中的家。 他們也在與不同客戶的接觸過程中，見證了各式各樣與「家」相關的人生百態。

programme.title: 我的女俠羅明依
programme.desc: 在明朝嘉靖年間，羅明依從小崇拜百年前下西洋的三寶太監，渴望未來也能航海遠洋。明依的師兄李時珍牽涉宮廷陰謀，遭到錦衣衛畢正追殺。明依冒險救出李時珍，與畢正在山洞內激戰，一道閃電降臨，將明依和畢正穿越到現代的新加坡……

programme.title: 霹靂俠峰
programme.desc: 北境三劍論俠峰，萬魔之罪七皇蹤， 河圖鬼智計無諝，岳雲深處現玉龍。 奉天逍遙踏入三途流域，又會開啟怎樣的旅程？名劍絕世與皇劍孤臣，能否解開白羽境天道之謎，阻止八歧邪神與死神？莫召奴、談無慾、淨琉璃等中原群俠，又該如何應對未知的危機？煉魔塔又是怎樣的存在？逆神七皇究竟是哪七人？欲知一連串精彩發展，盡在霹靂俠峰。

programme.title: 台南好生活
programme.desc: 結合深度走訪與人文情懷，以在地人視角出發，深入走讀舊城區，尋訪巷弄特色；記錄各行各業職人的百態，表現出城市文化中屬於「人」的溫度；透過現代文創為傳統產業重塑價值，不僅傳承更賦予新生。

programme.title: 小娘惹之翡翠山第28集
programme.desc: 心娘自幼跟著嗜賭成性的娘惹養母蔡阿珠四處流浪，過著朝不保夕的生活。雖然生長環境艱苦，她卻像野草般堅韌頑強，自有一套生存之道，年紀雖小，卻能撐過風雨摧折。她性格倔強、聰明狡黠，機靈滑頭、伶牙俐齒。為了活命，常與養母「狼狽為奸」地行騙，但始終保有善良本性，絕不對老弱傷殘出手，偶爾還會施捨幾分。

programme.title: 舊情綿綿第4集
programme.desc: 這是一個恩怨情仇，前後糾葛了四十餘年的故事。台灣光復前後，嘉義布袋大地主之子顏海豬、燒炭工的兒子汪邦雄，與佃農的女兒林桂蓮，這三個身分地位懸殊的童年玩伴，因為現實的捉弄而走上不同的命運。

programme.title: 愛你沒條件第59集
programme.desc: 金鐘導演李岳峰最新力作。「愛你沒條件」展現親情的溫暖、家庭的­珍貴與堅韌樂觀的生命態度，呈現台灣家庭濃烈而獨特的情感特色，講述80年代台灣歌舞團員的故事。

programme.title: 愛你沒條件第60集
programme.desc: 金鐘導演李岳峰最新力作。「愛你沒條件」展現親情的溫暖、家庭的­珍貴與堅韌樂觀的生命態度，呈現台灣家庭濃烈而獨特的情感特色，講述80年代台灣歌舞團員的故事。

programme.title: 天之蕉子第31集
programme.desc: 落地哭三聲，好壞命生成，每個人都是天之驕子，且看這群天之驕子如何在逆境成長，如何改變命運，利用一擔擔的香蕉，創造自己的黃金時代……遊手好閒的蕉農第三代高志鴻，與青果大盤商千金江秀蓮因誤會而相戀，秀蓮的妹妹秀玉在某次意外事件中，因志鴻幫秀玉解危讓秀玉暗戀志鴻，另外，志鴻的死黨柯忠義對秀蓮也悄生愛慕之情，命運無情的捉弄以及反派張瑞坤的撩撥，擾亂了眾人情感的一池春水，這五個花樣年華的年輕人，情感走向究竟如何？這是一個民國50~60年代，台灣盛產香蕉的輝煌歲月，南部小農村的羅密歐與茱麗葉的愛情故事，講述遊手好閒的蕉農第三代高志鴻，與青果大盤商千金江秀蓮因誤會而相戀，秀蓮的妹妹秀玉在某次意外事件中因志鴻

programme.title: 三國演議第499集
programme.desc: 深入世界中心，針貶天下大事，侃談國際風雲。

programme.title: Good morning 台灣第320集
programme.desc: 《Good Morning 台灣》帶來最新的時事、天氣、交通、以及健康、美食等各類話題，讓你在一天的開始獲得最佳的資訊與靈感。

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第52集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第53集

programme.title: 包青天第80集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 新哆啦Ａ夢第265集
programme.desc: 全新版本的哆啦A夢變得更小巧可愛，其他角色也有些微的變化，但故事依舊充滿趣味！故事開始時，我們認識到一個運動神經不佳、考試總是拿零分、超級懶散又愛睡覺的小學生-野比大雄。有一天，一隻貓型機器人【哆啦Ａ夢】乘坐時光機從二十二世紀來到了大雄的房間。原來，這是大雄的曾孫【小世修】為了改變大雄悲慘的人生，特地將【哆啦Ａ夢】送到他身邊。

programme.title: 天之蕉子第32集

programme.title: 包青天第82集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 我們的島第1352集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.desc: 真假新聞充斥，我們如何快速分辨真偽？本節目透過策略選擇與即時反應，打造高張力比賽。運用壯闊場景設計，打造通往知識殿堂的階梯，帶來震撼視覺體驗。

programme.title: 獨立特派員第947集
programme.desc: 公共電視新聞部的十多名記者與工作人員，將回到自己的頻道，開闢一個兼具調查採訪和新聞雜誌性質的新聞專題節目，「獨立特派員」。 調查性或雜誌型態的電視新聞專題節目，往往是一個電視台的新聞實力指標。為了在公共電視開闢調查性的新聞專題節目，服務更多觀眾，我們將以「新聞專題節目的領導品牌」為目標，回到公視頻道製播獨立、深度的調查性報導，以及提供多元、寬廣視野的新聞專題。

programme.title: 寇住幸福第21集

programme.title: 遇見祝福第9集
programme.desc: 福音短片，每天三分鐘，能夠重新激發您的力量並蒙受祝福！這些短片以生活化的例證，幫助朋友們更深入地認識耶穌！讓您在忙碌的生活中，用短短三分鐘，與福音相連，並與耶穌建立更親密的關係！

programme.title: 真情部落格第751集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 福氣人生第532集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第1495集
programme.desc: 跟隨寇紹恩牧師，每天五分鐘，領受上帝的話語，並將其應用到實際生活中。這樣我們可以每天都在上帝的愛和恩典中浸泡。

programme.title: 經典音樂河第51集
programme.desc: 節目中除了膾炙人口的聖詩演唱和演奏外，還有旁白將詩歌背後的故事和歌詞意境生動地道出來。同時，精彩的台灣大自然景觀影片作為背景，為觀眾帶來視覺上的享受。節目的目標是在聽覺、視覺和心靈層面上陪伴觀眾，在他們每一天的生活中營造美好的時光。

programme.title: 恩雨之聲第626集
programme.desc: 梁燕城博士和譚品立牧師將攜手帶領觀眾進行一場精彩的旅程，探索世界各地的基督教遺跡，深入研究這些地方的文化根源。他們將帶領觀眾欣賞廣闊而壯麗的風景，讓大家的眼界得到拓展。

programme.title: 生命真道之豐盛人生第458集
programme.desc: 基督徒必看的節目。它的系列節目叫做「生命真道」，每週一播出。在這個節目中，我們邀請了來自國內外的講員，他們通過深入的教義解釋和精闢的信息，向教友們傳達神的信息。

programme.title: 生命轉折點第51集
programme.desc: 大衛耶利米牧師以他深入淺出、精準又嚴謹的教導，將上帝永恆不變的真理傳達給聽眾。

programme.title: 真情部落格第751集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 禱告大軍迎接復興第1414集

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第96集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 都市開基祖第3集
programme.desc: 捷運工頭阿財，帶領工班兄弟參與著隧道工程，為了讓女兒學音樂的他，以及各自有夢的工班兄弟，在開挖的隧道中，意外挖出一把詭異的武士刀，隨後也接連發生諸多不可思議的巧合；此時，臺灣首位女工地主任美莉，也奮力在工地陽剛文化環境中證明著自己，但她也因此，踏上了重重危機的旅途。

programme.title: 客家新聞雜誌第991集
programme.desc: 由陳美禎主持，以客家人的觀點，結合時事和近期舉辦的各種客家活動，做詳盡而深入的各種專題探討和介紹。

programme.title: 福氣來了第15集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 幕後有藝思第21集
programme.desc: 《幕後有藝思》 邀您探索幕後大小事!

programme.title: 嗨客嘶第3集
programme.desc: 《嗨客嘶》是一個以公路旅行為主題的戶外節目。我們將聚焦在台灣著名的「台3線」和「台9線」上，並造訪沿線的客家庄，探索當地的美食和秘境。節目的主持人是許弘霖先生，他被譽為「全台灣最年輕宮廟總幹事」，也自稱為「觀音金乘五」。他以幽默風格主持節目，創造出輕鬆活潑且搞笑的內容。這個節目非常適合在緊張的時刻緩解壓力，我們希望透過愉快的製作帶

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所第3集
programme.desc: 邀請各路高手擔任所長與您分享好音樂與創作心情，讓您睡前在美妙的歌聲中放下一整天緊繃的情緒，三不五時還會告訴你音樂小知識。

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第89集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第322集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 自學，學到哪裡去第2集
programme.desc: 紀錄因在台灣教育體制受挫而選擇自學之青少年，跨出教室接觸百工百業，從自身出發，透過劇場實習學習情感教育、透過劇組實習習得職業技能，進而從公益志工學習社會參與，並每集同步邀訪紀錄在該領域中努力耕耘的青少年。

programme.title: 魔法小廚師第37集
programme.desc: 講述在特魯利城堡裡，四名主角的美食冒險故事，主角們的老師熱愛烹飪，擁有一本珍貴的祖傳食譜，按照食譜還原美食是他們主要學習目標，而在製作每一道美味料理的過程中，小廚師們漸漸也學會了許多人生中的智慧。但壞心眼的大鬍子阿庫伯總會出現費盡心思想不勞而獲，因此必要時大家會使出魔法阻止大鬍子的詭計，他們隱藏著神祕身分默默守護王國。

programme.desc: 節目邀請五位臺韓主持人，橫跨不同世代與領域，在山路旅程中共同走讀客家古道。這不只是一次文化體驗，更是一場跨文化的理解行動，希望觀眾可以和藝人一起，用最慢的方式，去靠近一個族群的生命節奏。在古道上，走出一種新的理解，也讓那些藏在山路裡的客家故事，再一次被看見、被傾聽、被記住。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第2集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(海陸腔)第15集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(海陸腔)第165集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個關於四位好朋友的故事，他們相聚在一起時，總是充滿著對話、爭吵和歡笑。

programme.title: 活力新故鄉第111集
programme.desc: 所有的不確定是動能的來源，故鄉的底蘊。活力新故鄉，故鄉新活力漫漫湠散中。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第97集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 《初心。登場》單歌第2集
programme.desc: 延續「客家製譟」音樂盛典品牌，2025年結合實境拍攝全新打造「初心。登場」系列節目，團隊跨越近一年時間紀錄八組音樂人回歸創作初心，挑戰前所未有的「第一次」登台。從平均年齡最年輕的樂團到搖滾天后，從獨立另類到流行經典，囊括金曲得主、經典唱將、演唱團體、亮眼新秀，多樣曲風加上最感動的創作初心，聯手專業團隊打造出耗資千萬的演唱會！

programme.title: 都市開基祖第3集
programme.desc: 捷運工頭阿財，帶領工班兄弟參與著隧道工程，為了讓女兒學音樂的他，以及各自有夢的工班兄弟，在開挖的隧道中，意外挖出一把詭異的武士刀，隨後也接連發生諸多不可思議的巧合；此時，臺灣首位女工地主任美莉，也奮力在工地陽剛文化環境中證明著自己，但她也因此，踏上了重重危機的旅途。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1151集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第21集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理為起點，透過食材的生產關係、食物的料理過程乃至廚師的烹飪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》試著以人與料理的故事，建立與客家概念的連結與對照，勾勒客家飲食多元豐富的面向。

programme.title: 福氣來了第16集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 客客客棧第7集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你會聯想到什麼？硬頸精神、勤勞節儉、客家美食，還是滿天飛舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎麼來的呢？又有什麼樣有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(海陸腔)第15集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: 魔法小廚師第39集
programme.desc: 講述在特魯利城堡裡，四名主角的美食冒險故事，主角們的老師熱愛烹飪，擁有一本珍貴的祖傳食譜，按照食譜還原美食是他們主要學習目標，而在製作每一道美味料理的過程中，小廚師們漸漸也學會了許多人生中的智慧。但壞心眼的大鬍子阿庫伯總會出現費盡心思想不勞而獲，因此必要時大家會使出魔法阻止大鬍子的詭計，他們隱藏著神祕身分默默守護王國。

programme.title: 魔法小廚師第40集
programme.desc: 講述在特魯利城堡裡，四名主角的美食冒險故事，主角們的老師熱愛烹飪，擁有一本珍貴的祖傳食譜，按照食譜還原美食是他們主要學習目標，而在製作每一道美味料理的過程中，小廚師們漸漸也學會了許多人生中的智慧。但壞心眼的大鬍子阿庫伯總會出現費盡心思想不勞而獲，因此必要時大家會使出魔法阻止大鬍子的詭計，他們隱藏著神祕身分默默守護王國。

programme.title: 自學，學到哪裡去第4集
programme.desc: 紀錄因在台灣教育體制受挫而選擇自學之青少年，跨出教室接觸百工百業，從自身出發，透過劇場實習學習情感教育、透過劇組實習習得職業技能，進而從公益志工學習社會參與，並每集同步邀訪紀錄在該領域中努力耕耘的青少年。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1152集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第97集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 飛越客庄第2集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 村民大會-過家尞聊正事第86集
programme.desc: 打造一台行動雜貨店，駛入客庄大街小巷，歡迎鄉親一起來喝茶聊天，暢談地方議題，大人小孩都來「過家尞聊正事」，關心客庄大小事！

programme.title: 懂吃懂吃來煮食第58集
programme.desc: 踏上歡愉的旅程，烹煮出暖心的滋味！

programme.desc: 《幕後有藝思》 邀您探索幕後大小事!

programme.title: 嗨客嘶第4集
programme.desc: 《嗨客嘶》是一個以公路旅行為主題的戶外節目。我們將聚焦在台灣著名的「台3線」和「台9線」上，並造訪沿線的客家庄，探索當地的美食和秘境。節目的主持人是許弘霖先生，他被譽為「全台灣最年輕宮廟總幹事」，也自稱為「觀音金乘五」。他以幽默風格主持節目，創造出輕鬆活潑且搞笑的內容。這個節目非常適合在緊張的時刻緩解壓力，我們希望透過愉快的製作帶

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所第4集
programme.desc: 邀請各路高手擔任所長與您分享好音樂與創作心情，讓您睡前在美妙的歌聲中放下一整天緊繃的情緒，三不五時還會告訴你音樂小知識。

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第90集

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第323集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1579集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(大埔腔)第165集
programme.desc: 朋友聚在一起時，總是會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，以及許多有趣的故事。這個節目「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」，描述的就是四個好朋友間的種種經歷和冒險故事。

programme.title: 懂吃懂吃來煮食第58集
programme.desc: 踏上歡愉的旅程，烹煮出暖心的滋味！

programme.title: 當晝新聞第98集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 《初心。登場》單歌第3集
programme.desc: 延續「客家製譟」音樂盛典品牌，2025年結合實境拍攝全新打造「初心。登場」系列節目，團隊跨越近一年時間紀錄八組音樂人回歸創作初心，挑戰前所未有的「第一次」登台。從平均年齡最年輕的樂團到搖滾天后，從獨立另類到流行經典，囊括金曲得主、經典唱將、演唱團體、亮眼新秀，多樣曲風加上最感動的創作初心，聯手專業團隊打造出耗資千萬的演唱會！

programme.title: 都市開基祖第4集
programme.desc: 捷運工頭阿財，帶領工班兄弟參與著隧道工程，為了讓女兒學音樂的他，以及各自有夢的工班兄弟，在開挖的隧道中，意外挖出一把詭異的武士刀，隨後也接連發生諸多不可思議的巧合；此時，臺灣首位女工地主任美莉，也奮力在工地陽剛文化環境中證明著自己，但她也因此，踏上了重重危機的旅途。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1152集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 一家之煮第457集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第25集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家庄裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 客客客棧第8集
programme.desc: 提到「客家」，你會聯想到什麼？硬頸精神、勤勞節儉、客家美食，還是滿天飛舞的桐花？而「客家」，又是怎麼來的呢？又有什麼樣有趣的小故事？

programme.title: 繪聲繪影第4集
programme.desc: 《繪聲繪影》由說書人「阿佳」和手偶「莎士比喵」帶領大、小朋友進入故事書的世界，讓閱讀不再限制於平面紙張，使繪本故事中的人物鮮活起來，將故事的進行配合原圖製作成簡易的動畫，藉由影音刺激，產生更多層次感官體驗與娛樂效果，多樣化的閱讀得到前所未有的延伸，提高自我學習的意願與興趣。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻第4集
programme.desc: 「學學嘴學學鼻」與孩子們唱唱跳跳學客語，期望從學齡前幼兒到國高中生，皆能從中找到語言、文化的趣味，或學習從不同觀點看世界。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1588集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第98集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 飛越客庄第3集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 溜麵線雜貨店第6集
programme.desc: 節目場景復刻了早期客莊鄰里間最熱鬧、也最能聊天的雜貨店前空地。在這裡，沒有刻板的說教，只有銀髮長輩與主持人，像在大樹下乘涼般，自在地聊生活、聊煩惱，也聊那些平常說不出口的心事。

programme.title: 誰來作客第87集
programme.desc: 一個以「客」為尊的節目，邀請嘉賓以輕鬆閒聊的方式閒話家常。

programme.title: 愛的辛香料第23集
programme.desc: 19世紀的泰國，一對姊妹進入宮廷御膳房學習料理。姊姊萬德活潑外向，妹妹安諾溫柔賢淑。她們努力生活，創造美味料理，也抓住愛人的心。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第14季:第19集
programme.desc: 為了尋找稀有的古董家飾，德魯與堤伊驅車前往科赤斯特的廢品回收場，以及古董商店蓬勃發展的濱海小鎮哈斯丁，更千里迢迢來到偏遠的托斯尼特和朋布洛克小鎮挖寶。他們發掘了許多獨一無二的古董，像是別具魅力的三口洗手台、一幅古怪的輪胎廣告插畫以及50年代的美式咖啡桌，甚至還找到一個裝滿中國紀念品而且密封了50年的行李箱！

programme.title: 野地造屋第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 年輕夫妻傑森和凱西來到人煙稀少的聖赫勒納島野地造屋，從事建造業的傑森自己找團隊施工，在有限的時間和預算下建造夫妻心目中的夢想雙體船式住家，體驗野地造屋的辛苦與樂趣。

programme.title: 圖坦卡門失落之城第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 古埃及的法老為了獲得永生，必須在死亡前準備好陵墓和祭祀神廟。圖坦卡門之墓在近一百年前已經被發現了，考古學家接著要尋找的，就是他的祭祀神廟。但他們在尋找這座神廟時，卻意外地做出更重要的發現。他們發掘出一座巨大的古城。人們常說古埃及是一個沒有城市的文明，但這座出土的古城就證明了古埃及也有城市。王宮和神廟所需的一切，甚至是圖坦卡門之墓的寶藏，都是這裡的工匠提供的。他們造就了名垂千古的圖坦卡門。沒有他們，圖坦卡門將只是一具默默無聞的木乃伊。

programme.title: 漁人的搏鬥第18季:第6集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，史托巴斯號的席格船長跟特隆瑟汀號的野人比爾船長要在挪威做最後衝刺，再來準備返回阿拉斯加。柯妮瑪莉號的喬許跟凱西船長要盡快捕到金帝王蟹，才能及時回港變更裝備，改捕紅眼雪蟹。派翠西亞李號的利普船長則希望能一改先前的厄運，平安無事地順利豐收。他們能越過種種挑戰，帶回滿滿的漁獲嗎？

programme.title: 漁人的搏鬥第18季:第7集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，派翠西亞李號的利普船長再次面對船員受傷的危機，南風號的哈里船長要帶領菜鳥船員解決機械故障的問題，柯妮瑪莉號的喬許跟凱西要試著跟巫師號的基斯船長合作找出螃蟹的位置。他們能越過種種挑戰，帶回滿滿的漁獲嗎？

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 一同探索極北之地狼群、北極熊與海象的生存爭鬥，以及夏季降臨時，北美馴鹿遷徙與鮭魚逆流而上的壯闊景象。

programme.title: 金礦的賭注第16季:第9集
programme.desc: 大火的威脅令派克在採完硫磺溪的黃金前就必須關閉礦場。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第14季:第20集
programme.desc: 德魯的店裡需要新的商品，於是他與堤伊再度驅車上路。這次的目的地包括位於艾色克斯的回收中心、在威爾斯舉辦的國際古董展、位於倫敦的古玩店，以及索塞克斯的拍賣會。德魯發揮他獨到的眼光、強勢議價與交易手腕，在各地大展身手，購入許多獨特的商品。

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第3季:第21集
programme.desc: 加州千橡市的倉庫拍賣會即將開始，但艾倫仍在路上，湯只好單槍匹馬參加拍賣會。

programme.title: 倉儲挖寶王第3季:第22集
programme.desc: 艾倫和湯今天來到湯的家鄉加州羚羊谷。當地地域遼闊，吸引航空公司和越野玩家聚集，因此艾倫和湯打算特別留意高檔工具和高科技機械。

programme.title: 漁人的搏鬥第18季:第8集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，為了捕到足夠的漁獲量，船長們紛紛採取新方法。西北號的席格船長要聽從女婿的直覺，時光大盜號的強納森船長要探索海底深處，艾琳諾潔號的尚恩船長要向過世的老爸學習，傳說號的傑克船長則是要面對血親受傷的風險。他們能越過種種挑戰，帶回滿滿的漁獲嗎？

programme.title: 漁人的搏鬥第18季:第9集
programme.desc: 西北號船長席格在捕捉紅眼雪蟹時，女兒曼蒂也即將臨盆，而且疑似有前置血管的症狀，這個消息讓席格與他的女婿克拉克非常擔心，於是他們轉移陣地到靠近沿岸的漁場，準備隨時返航。傳說號的傑克船長遍尋不著裸蓋魚的蹤跡，因此他求助派翠西亞李號的利普，卻不慎讓兩艘船的魚籠和蟹籠纏在一起，傑克感到非常自責，最後用金帝王蟹的情報挽回合作關係。

programme.title: 西班牙海港護衛隊第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 一艘貨櫃船在巴塞隆納港差點擱淺，而一場暴風雨差點延誤了要從伊比薩港航向瓦倫西亞港的渡輪，阿赫西拉斯港的拖船得對抗長浪與強風，在半小時內讓一艘近400公尺長的船隻安全停泊。

programme.title: 西班牙海港護衛隊第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 帕馬斯港的港務人員正趕著把緊急人道救援物資準備好以送往西非的多哥，維哥港的港務人員必須確認漁獲數量，好讓魚市的拍賣會順利進行，塔拉哥納港則得卸下船上沈重的鋼材，好運往家電工廠。

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第5集

programme.title: 圖坦卡門失落之城第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 古埃及的法老為了獲得永生，必須在死亡前準備好陵墓和祭祀神廟。圖坦卡門之墓在近一百年前已經被發現了，考古學家接著要尋找的，就是他的祭祀神廟。但他們在尋找這座神廟時，卻意外地做出更重要的發現。他們發掘出一座巨大的古城。人們常說古埃及是一個沒有城市的文明，但這座出土的古城就證明了古埃及也有城市。王宮和神廟所需的一切，甚至是圖坦卡門之墓的寶藏，都是這裡的工匠提供的。他們造就了名垂千古的圖坦卡門。沒有他們，圖坦卡門將只是一具默默無聞的木乃伊。

programme.title: 翻新中古車第18季:第2集
programme.desc: 麥克買到一輛紅色的保時捷911 SC，這個經典車款在市場上非常受歡迎，價格通常很昂貴，但這輛因為狀況不佳，所以價格相當划算。艾維斯發揮他的工程專長修復這輛車的翼子板，並將引擎翻新過一遍，麥克則是為它訂製了一塊全新的加熱擋風玻璃。兩人想將這輛經典跑車翻新成一輛實用的日常用車。

programme.title: 舊貨獵人修復篇第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 羅伯肯恩找到一匹支離破碎的木馬，因為這是維多利亞時代的代表性玩具，而且經過專家認證之後，這匹木馬出自萊恩斯兄弟之手，因此羅伯動用三名專業修復師，木工艾利克斯、皮匠馬汀和彩繪師吉兒，三人通力合作，完成這個史詩般的修復工程。德魯照例又想挑戰雕刻師尼克的功力，拿來一座殘缺不全的雕像，希望透過尼克的巧手，讓這座雕像恢復少女魅力。

programme.title: 翻新中古車第18季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集翻新中古車，麥克相中英國車史上最醜的車款之一，奧斯汀阿勒格羅。儘管阿勒格羅是出了名的爛車，麥克卻認為凡登普拉的版本已有所強化，且賣家的車況保持良好，內裝近似全新，於是堅持買下。之後由艾維斯處理懸吊系統和噴漆，麥克則把儀表板拿去重新印膜，總算讓這輛車裡外都煥然一新。最後前往水上伯頓參加車聚，見到許多外觀奇特的怪車，也成功搭上真心喜愛凡登普拉的買家。

programme.title: 麥克布魯爾-天生車商第1季:第6集

programme.title: 人體不思議第6季:第12集
programme.desc: 墨西哥的艾卓安患有多囊性纖維性結構不全，使右臉逐漸長出一顆巨瘤，到了壓迫口鼻和眼睛，因此在成長完全後接受此生最大規模的切除手術。術後，雖然臉部重建之路漫漫，但他勇敢開創新人生。罹患原發性淋巴水腫的珍妮絲，右腿長了兩個巨大淋巴瘤，儘管丈夫悉心照護，她還是為了保命接受切除手術。甩掉重擔的她，開始對未來感到期待。印度一對兄弟罹患神秘疾病，經檢查發現，他們的症狀主要是加速老化，但不完全符合早衰症，現在要等德國的基因檢測結果出爐，才能釐清確切病症。

programme.title: 風城改造專家第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本週艾莉森和唐納文將迎接從業以來最大規模的改造計畫：一間位在芝加哥威克公園旁，歷史街道上的地標房屋。先花幾個月解決了二樓佔屋者及地標局審核等問題，再設法保留房屋正面磚牆和飛簷。將房子往後和往下延伸增加建築面積，融合新舊、古典和現代化元素，打造出帶有濃厚芝加哥風情，價值兩百萬的寬敞獨棟住宅。

programme.title: 時人雜誌犯罪調查第4季:第5集

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第11集

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗第16季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，藍迪回顧節目裡多年來的名人出場時刻，無論是新娘本人、家人、或是朋友，這些名人用自己的獨到眼光，為新娘挑選出最適合的夢幻婚紗。她們或許不是時尚專家，卻都想讓新娘穿上最完美的禮服，星光閃耀般踏上紅毯。

programme.title: 離開美國結婚去第7季:第3集
programme.desc: 強尼擔心克蘿伊難以適應新環境；路克出發前遭麥德琳封鎖。安東尼與瑪儂登機時衝突升級，葛蕾塔不滿馬修未定住處，珍妮與蘇密則為了生意努力議價。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第9季:第8集
programme.desc: 來自泰國清邁的諾特去卡加立就學，離鄉多年後，他帶著想當廚師的芙蘿拉回到家鄉，希望在探索泰式料理之餘順便維繫感情，但他們尋屋的條件卻截然不同。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第9季:第9集
programme.desc: 本集來自加拿大的尼克與瑞秋想脫離原有生活，在柬埔寨展開新冒險。尼克追求當地傳統的住宿風格，瑞秋則希望家裡能有便利的西方設備。

programme.title: 整脊最上手第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 開朗的科隆醫師一如往常，用樂觀的態度處理各種複雜的狀況。雖然整脊無法根除患者的疾病，卻能緩解他們緊繃的身體部位，讓他們的日常生活更舒服自在。

programme.title: 免拆屋大改造第1季:第1集

programme.title: 豪華原木屋第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 一直環遊世界的戴文轉型成在家經營自己的生意後，決定在維吉尼亞州購買原木屋定居，並請來好友帕麗和凱文幫忙看房。

programme.title: 豪華原木屋第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 戴爾和蘇珊多年來常到明尼蘇達州度假，現在他們決定在這裡的湖畔買一間度假木屋，離親朋好友更近。

programme.title: 貝琳大聲說第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 杜普利一家抵達倫敦！他們必須迅速適應文化衝擊。搭乘觀光巴士時，貝琳因過度刺激導致抽動症狀加劇。

programme.title: 風城改造專家第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 買家向艾莉森維多莉亞在巴克鎮的翻修屋提出全價出價，但是有個條件。

programme.title: 我是尚娜雷第2季:第10集
programme.desc: 尚娜與蕾莉在布魯克林找到一間公寓，兩人要在此短暫試住，體驗獨立生活的滋味。

programme.title: 修復英式莊園第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 跟隨建築師迪恩波頓Dean Poulton與設計師博賈馬夸Borja de Maqua，看他們親手修復一座曾屬於亨利七世國王、歷經三百年歲月洗禮的英式莊園。這座曾經宏偉卻日漸破敗的皇家遺跡，在兩人的巧思與工藝下，從中世紀風格重生，蛻變成夢幻莊園。

programme.title: 大廚荷西全家遊西班牙第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 荷西和三個女兒卡蘿塔、伊奈絲和露西亞來到蘭札羅提島。

programme.title: 問題皮膚救星第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 四名受到皮膚問題困擾的患者登門尋求艾瑪醫師的協助。

programme.title: 時人雜誌犯罪調查第4季:第7集
programme.desc: 1996年洛杉磯華埠一起殺人案震驚了好萊塢，獲得奧斯卡最佳男配角獎的吳漢潤竟陳屍其寓所旁的停車棚。吳漢潤是來自柬埔寨的醫師，他在紅色高棉政權下失去了妻子和家人，後來帶著姪女蘇菲亞逃到美國，展開新生活。因緣際會下，他去參加電影殺戮戰場的試鏡並錄取了，該片描述赤柬政權對柬埔寨的恐怖管制。他得到奧斯卡獎後就運用自身名氣來為柬埔寨人發聲，經常公開表達對赤柬政權的不滿。因此當他遇害的消息傳出後，外界第一時間都懷疑這是政治暗殺，不過蘇菲亞不經意的一句話，卻讓案情偵查有了新方向！

programme.title: 最膩姊妹檔第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 澳洲雙胞胎露西與安娜對理髮提出誇張要求；蘭笛與喬登夢想著找一對雙胞胎兄弟結婚；小薇想替艾許莉代孕，但艾許莉擔心小薇會因此跟丈夫與孩子生隙。

programme.title: 亞洲房屋獵人第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 阿黛兒自從16歲開始就夢想擁有自己的家，如今35歲的她已經準備好邁出一大步購買自己的房子。

programme.title: 亞洲房屋獵人第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 馬來西亞的亞文和玲要找一棟新房子，由於家族人多這個五口之家需要可以容納十口人以上的房子。亞文和玲能否找到夢想中的房子，有足夠的房間來容納他們的大家族？

programme.title: 跟著艾琳去流浪第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 冬季來臨，秘境廚房暫停營業。艾琳與老公麥可來到路易斯安納州深入瞭解在地人的家鄉味，從中找到靈感。

programme.title: 風城改造專家第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 本集艾莉森來到座落於詹森大道上的房子進行改造；為求降低成本，不僅得保留原有的四套出租住房格局，更得符合林肯公園社區的高檔品味，究竟她會完成什麼樣的作品？

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 凱蒂伯頓前往楓糖漿廠去深入了解自然楓糖漿的製作過程。狄安娜尼爾森和保羅霍爾德曼兩位廠主和其他楓糖漿製造商作法不同，以自然保留樹木原始風味的方法來製作每批楓糖漿。在每道過程細心蒸發熬煮，產出的楓糖漿香氣與風味也隨之與眾不同。

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，凱蒂今天要使用的食材是海帶，海帶對美國人來說是一種很少食用的食材；然而海帶的美味以及帶給環境的益處卻超乎所想。凱蒂將用海帶料理奶油培根義大利麵，而海帶料理專家伊爾瑪也將帶來海帶吉拿棒料理。

programme.title: 免拆屋大改造第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，珍要幫三個小孩的單親媽媽海莉改造居家環境，海莉家中充滿50年代糖果色調，而且幾乎沒有收納空間。而另一組客戶的房子空間雖大，卻沒善加利用，屋內還有各種老舊設計。珍這次會用什麼妙招，進行免拆屋大改造呢？

programme.title: 亞洲房屋獵人第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 文斯和淑緹在新加坡東部租屋已經七年了，這對有一個兩歲小孩的夫婦，已準備好購置新家迎接更多孩子出世。

programme.title: 亞洲房屋獵人第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 夏魯成年之後大部分都是租房子，但是好客的他準備好要買一間自己的房子，方便招待朋友。

programme.title: 為了媽媽去殺人第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 原本該是最純粹的母子羈絆，卻演變成陰謀操控與致命背叛。節目攤開令人毛骨悚然的真實案件，在貪婪與復仇的驅使下，親情如何扭曲成為殘酷的犯罪，在美國各地留下無法抹去的傷痕。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第5季:第1集
programme.desc: 傑克是一隻約一歲大的流浪貓。從牠脖子上的項圈看來，牠一定也是隻曾受到主人呵護的小貓。牠可能是在很小的時候就離家出走，或遭到棄養。因此牠獨自遊蕩有一段時間了，隨著牠不斷長大，項圈也慢慢嵌入牠的脖子，造成一整圈受到感染的傷口。獸醫很驚訝傑克在這種情況下還能活著，如果牠在長大一點，那牠很可能會被勒死。在醫療團隊的細心治療和照顧後，傑克的頸傷終於康復了。診所員工發現傑克雖然曾流浪很久，但並不是一隻野性難馴的貓，因此他們也為牠找到很有愛心的領養者。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 牠們是頂尖獵人、終極生存者，也是長久以來被誤解的掠食者。跟著節目揭開蛇的祕密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇類多樣的棲息地、非凡的適應能力，以及牠們與人類之間錯綜複雜的關係。迅速致命的偽裝大師，蛇類是地表上最令人畏懼的生物之一，每年造成超過十萬人死亡。然而，這些被貼標籤成危害人命的掠食者，其實往往是人類侵占棲地的受害者，也因此才引發一連串危險而難解的衝突。《蛇的秘密世界》帶領觀眾深入蛇類不為人知的一面，揭露牠們令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 喬治亞水族館原本有三隻白鯨，館方分別從德州與佛羅達州再引進一公一母的白鯨，組成更緊密的白鯨群。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 在塞倫蓋提平原上只有兩個季節，即乾季和濕季，雨水帶來新的開始，主宰生命的循環，大獸群在遷徙的旅程中生活備受考驗。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 塞倫蓋提的大獸群踏上遷徙的旅程，途中地形跟掠食者可能奪去牠們的性命，但是牠們必須踏上已有千年歷史的遷徙之路，抵達豐美的草地。

programme.title: 愛心動物農場第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 芝加哥動物照管中心有一批鬥雞有待認養，穀倉收容所預定協助認養一隻，結果帶回兩隻—漢彌爾頓與史特勞斯—以及一隻白狗溫特。丹到克莉絲汀當志工的動物收容所認養回兩隻小兔子—帕可與諾瓦—作為自己的寵物。因為他租的公寓不得養動物，所以他只好另覓新居，剛好弟弟克里斯不堪農場公雞一大清早叫他起床，於是和丹當起室友。小牛迪傑長大了，不適合與小動物待在一起，改搬去大牛的牧草地。迪傑的好哥們—盲眼牛麥克—很思念牠，丹讓麥克到大牧草地與迪傑相會，沒想到麥克竟能適應與大牛在一起。穀倉農場打算興建新豬舍，為現有的豬提供更大空間，還能收容更多隻豬。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 喬治亞水族館原本有三隻白鯨，館方分別從德州與佛羅達州再引進一公一母的白鯨，組成更緊密的白鯨群。

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 揭曉野地裡的最強爸媽，探究奇妙的育兒技巧和繁殖策略。

programme.title: 動物情深第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 芮伊哈維是一位野生動物保護志工。她在五十歲之前曾是樂團經理和活動發起人，但她的後半生和前半生卻大不相同。她在退休後成了一所野生動物中心的志工，因此喜歡上袋鼠，並建立了自己的袋鼠庇護所。在二０一九年的澳洲叢林大火中，她的庇護所被燒毀了，收容的袋鼠也都失散了。後來有隻名叫康酷的袋鼠回來了，牠還通知其他倖存的袋鼠來此避難。在袋鼠和芮伊的合作下，這些倖存的袋鼠終於能在此安心養傷。後來芮伊也重建了一座更新更好的庇護所。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 牠們是頂尖獵人、終極生存者，也是長久以來被誤解的掠食者。跟著節目揭開蛇的祕密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇類多樣的棲息地、非凡的適應能力，以及牠們與人類之間錯綜複雜的關係。迅速致命的偽裝大師，蛇類是地表上最令人畏懼的生物之一，每年造成超過十萬人死亡。然而，這些被貼標籤成危害人命的掠食者，其實往往是人類侵占棲地的受害者，也因此才引發一連串危險而難解的衝突。《蛇的秘密世界》帶領觀眾深入蛇類不為人知的一面，揭露牠們令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 愛心動物農場第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 芝加哥動物照管中心有一批鬥雞有待認養，穀倉收容所預定協助認養一隻，結果帶回兩隻—漢彌爾頓與史特勞斯—以及一隻白狗溫特。丹到克莉絲汀當志工的動物收容所認養回兩隻小兔子—帕可與諾瓦—作為自己的寵物。因為他租的公寓不得養動物，所以他只好另覓新居，剛好弟弟克里斯不堪農場公雞一大清早叫他起床，於是和丹當起室友。小牛迪傑長大了，不適合與小動物待在一起，改搬去大牛的牧草地。迪傑的好哥們—盲眼牛麥克—很思念牠，丹讓麥克到大牧草地與迪傑相會，沒想到麥克竟能適應與大牛在一起。穀倉農場打算興建新豬舍，為現有的豬提供更大空間，還能收容更多隻豬。

programme.title: 喬治亞水族館第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 保育員訓練海獺吉普森學習獨立，不再過度依靠同伴。51隻非洲企鵝被移至暫養池，好讓保育員進行展區年度大掃除。

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 揭曉自然界的偽裝高手，從微型刺客到頂級掠食者，全都是奇特的生物，展現出不可思議的力量。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第5季:第2集
programme.desc: 傑斯是熱血獸醫院的員工，蒂娜是他的愛犬。幾天前傑斯買了一包肥料，原本打算要搬進車庫存放。但蒂娜卻趁傑斯不在時吃了肥料。肥料中含有硫酸鉀，可能會腐蝕蒂娜的消化道。還好傑斯買的是有機肥料，其中並沒有強烈的化學藥劑。傑斯原本要為蒂娜注射催吐劑，但他緊張得無法完成，只好由佩特拉幫忙。他們為蒂娜催吐後，蒂娜的情況也穩定下來。接著他們又餵蒂娜吃活性碳，以吸收殘留在牠體內的有害物質。大多數的狗都覺得活性碳難以下嚥，但蒂娜卻吃得津津有味。

programme.title: 動物情深第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 芮伊哈維是一位野生動物保護志工。她在五十歲之前曾是樂團經理和活動發起人，但她的後半生和前半生卻大不相同。她在退休後成了一所野生動物中心的志工，因此喜歡上袋鼠，並建立了自己的袋鼠庇護所。在二０一九年的澳洲叢林大火中，她的庇護所被燒毀了，收容的袋鼠也都失散了。後來有隻名叫康酷的袋鼠回來了，牠還通知其他倖存的袋鼠來此避難。在袋鼠和芮伊的合作下，這些倖存的袋鼠終於能在此安心養傷。後來芮伊也重建了一座更新更好的庇護所。

programme.title: 愛心動物農場第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 丹接到蘿菈的求助電話，她酪農場裡剛出生的小山羊後腿肌腱斷裂，希望有能力的收容所能收留牠，否則牠將面臨安樂死。幸好牠年紀小，復健過程相當順利，一個月後就能和其他動物一起生活。夏天的牧草地有大量虻群肆虐，母牛群和驢群都不勝其擾，農場團隊想出舉辦洗車募款的點子，購買大型洗車刷來讓動物們抓癢，避免虻群叮咬的情況惡化。母驢瑪莉皮特因為罹患蹄葉炎而有慢性疼痛，團隊用心替牠進行治療，所幸牠的膿瘍順利消退，疼痛也大幅減少。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 《超能動物》探索棲息在地球上奇妙又驚人的生物。每一集主題透過震撼的大自然影像、漫畫風格的視覺效果，搭配不可思議的小知識，展現這些不同凡響的動物，巧妙結合自然歷史與流行文化，寓教於樂，適合所有年齡層的觀眾一同觀賞。

programme.title: 超能動物第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 揭示蝗蟲、水蜘蛛、大熊貓與皇蛾等動物，如何完成不可思議的轉化與變態過程，證明現實自然界中的轉變同樣令人驚嘆。

programme.title: 野性尚比亞第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 尚比亞盧安瓜河谷深處的一處烏木林裡住著一群黃狒狒，狒狒群不只要面對外在的威脅，在族群內部也有危險，狒狒寶寶的生活更是危機四伏，灰白色的馬庫巴是群裡的異類，更糟的是，牠的媽媽尼瑪是最低階的母狒狒，母子兩個常常遭到霸凌，更有母狒狒常常想要綁架馬庫巴，群裡的另一隻母狒狒奇松妮剛生下兒子，兒子卻死在其他笨拙的母狒狒手上，孤寂的牠後來和外來的流亡者獨眼，一起加入尼瑪母子，這四隻狒狒聯手後，命運也開始轉變，未來的日子也許辛苦，但牠們可以一起面對，再也不是流亡者。

programme.title: 河中巨怪-謎樣水域第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 在南非的荒山野嶺中，據說有隻神祕河怪擁有奇怪力量，牠會把人帶走，傑洛米來到南非調查。

programme.title: 動物求生策略第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 繁殖是決定生存與滅絕的關鍵，動物為獲得交配機會相互競爭。
